project.name: 智教星首页重设计

intentProfile.routingReason: User requests two new show-off variants (v4/v5) built on v3 baseline, demonstrating strong frontend fundamentals with motion and transitions, low AI-feel. Variant generation keeps v3 as baseline.

lowValueCallWatchdog.noProgressNextAction: dispatch v4 and v5 page builds in parallel then validate

contextRequirementsLoaded.designRead: Canvas particle physics + CSS 3D scroll-driven animation patterns — frontend show-off, motion + transitions, low AI-feel
contextRequirementsLoaded.styleDefinitionBrief: Two show-off variants on v3 dark baseline: v4=Canvas Particle Knowledge Graph (force-directed node network as hero bg, data particles flowing on edges, mouse interaction, scroll-triggered SVG stroke animations, count-up numbers, clip-path reveals), v5=CSS 3D Scroll Cinematic (perspective+preserve-3d layered hero, scroll-driven rotateX/translateZ parallax, 3D card stack for agents, mouse parallax depth). Both keep dark theme, no left-right splits, no equal card grids. Motion is hand-written Canvas/CSS/JS — no generic fade-in-only AI patterns.
contextRequirementsLoaded.styleContinuityAnchors: v3 dark product-theater baseline preserved; v4 and v5 are structural variants differing in animation technology axis (Canvas physics vs CSS 3D transforms)

cssPreflightEvidence.notes: Both v4/v5 heads generated via apply-html-head-contract.mjs from colors_and_type-v3.css (dark theme). All contract requirements met.

visualQualityCheckpoints.anchor: v4 Hero: Canvas force-directed knowledge graph network as full-bleed bg, particles flow on edges, nodes breathe, mouse hover highlights node+connected edges, headline floats above
visualQualityCheckpoints.hierarchy: oversized H1 + Canvas layer behind + product UI card below
visualQualityCheckpoints.composition: centered, Canvas fills viewport, no split
visualQualityCheckpoints.strategy: requestAnimationFrame physics loop, performance-capped particle count, IntersectionObserver pause when offscreen

visualQualityCheckpoints.anchor: v5 Hero: CSS 3D perspective layered depth, headline/title/subtitle on different Z planes, mouse parallax tilts the scene, scroll drives rotateX reveal
visualQualityCheckpoints.hierarchy: 3D-layered H1 + parallax bg layers + scroll-driven section transitions
visualQualityCheckpoints.composition: centered, preserve-3d depth stack, no split
visualQualityCheckpoints.strategy: pure CSS 3D transforms + scroll event listener, transform-style: preserve-3d, will-change: transform

visualQualityCheckpoints.anchor: Both: scroll-triggered reveal animations with staggered timing, clip-path/transform variety (not all fade-in)
visualQualityCheckpoints.strategy: IntersectionObserver + CSS custom properties for stagger, clip-path polygon reveals, translateY/rotate/clip variety per section

contextRequirementsLoaded.variantAxis: animation technology: v4=Canvas 2D physics simulation, v5=CSS 3D transforms + scroll-driven parallax
contextRequirementsLoaded.comparisonGrouping: v4-vs-v5 motion showcase, both vs v3 static baseline

pages.title: 首页 v4 · Canvas 粒子知识图谱版
pages.variantAxis: Canvas 2D physics: force-directed knowledge graph network as hero, data particles flowing on edges, mouse-interactive node highlighting, scroll-triggered SVG stroke-dashoffset path animations, count-up number animations, clip-path polygon reveals
pages.visualNorthStar: Canvas particle knowledge graph hero — force-directed node network fills the viewport behind the headline, nodes breathe and connected by edges with flowing data particles. Mouse hover highlights a node and its connections. Scroll triggers SVG path drawing animations and staggered clip-path reveals. Numbers count up on enter. Terminal tech stack with typewriter effect. All motion is hand-written Canvas/CSS/JS, no generic fade-in-only AI patterns.

pages.title: 首页 v5 · CSS 3D 滚动叙事版
pages.variantAxis: CSS 3D transforms + scroll-driven parallax: perspective+preserve-3d layered hero depth, scroll drives rotateX/translateZ section transitions, 3D card stack for agents, mouse parallax tilt
pages.visualNorthStar: CSS 3D scroll cinematic — hero uses perspective with headline/title/subtitle on different Z planes, mouse movement tilts the entire scene. Scroll drives sections through 3D space (rotateX, translateZ). Agent cards stack in 3D and flip open on scroll. Feature sections parallax at different depths. All motion is pure CSS 3D transforms + scroll event, no Canvas, no generic fade-in-only AI patterns.
